videos.title: Cem Karsan Says This Bounce Doesn’t Make the Macro Healthy
videos.description:
Cem Karsan explains why this bounce was no surprise: flows are positive and the market is well hedged, so vol compression follows naturally. But he warns that doesn’t make the macro story healthy, with liquidity drying up in the one part of the market that has been driving the profits. Noel Smith adds that gamma is carrying positively in the extremely short term, a rare situation.
